narrative.overview:
The interface is a measuring instrument that stays out of its own readings. Ground, cards, borders and text are all achromatic, so the only saturated colour on a working screen is the runs themselves. Controls are small, dense and always visible: every setting behind a curve sits in that run's card beside its peak figures, never behind a menu.

Two themes exist and are the same design at opposite ends of the lightness scale: near-white ground with white cards, or near-black ground with slightly lifted cards. Every colour token is a single `light-dark()` pair on the root. The app follows the system by default; the Theme select in the top bar writes `data-theme` on the root element, which pins `color-scheme` to one side.

Depth is carried by hairline borders and a one-step tonal lift, not shadows. Type is one family at three weights in sentence case, with tabular numerals everywhere because most of what is on screen is a number.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic chrome; run data is the only saturated colour.
Light and dark themes from one set of `light-dark()` tokens, system-following with a manual override.
Hairline borders and tonal layering; a single shadow, on the modal dialog.
Dense controls: 28px fields, 32px buttons, 11px labels, 13px body.
Runs identified by colour and marker shape together; torque is dashed against solid power.
Run colour is for lines, markers and swatches; text about a run is always Ink.
One typeface (Geist Variable, self-hosted) at weights 400, 500 and 600.

rules.name: The Runs Own The Colour Rule
rules.body: Chrome is achromatic. Hue on screen means a run, the one primary action, a focus or selection state, or an error.

rules.name: The First Run Is Ink Rule
rules.body: The first run is drawn in Ink, so a single run, on screen and in the exported image, is fully monochrome. Colour appears only when there is something to compare.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: A run is always identified by colour and marker shape together, wherever it appears: card header swatch, legend, readout, line end, peak. Where one chart carries two quantities for a run, the right-axis one (torque) is dashed 5/4 and the left-axis one (power) is solid.

rules.name: The Ink Text Rule
rules.body: Run colour is for lines, markers and swatches. Text about a run (peak figures on the canvas, values in the readout, names in the legend and the exported image) is Ink, and is tied to its run by the swatch beside it or the marker it sits on.

rules.name: The Canvas Mirror Rule
rules.body: The chart canvas cannot read CSS custom properties. Chart.svelte holds literal light and dark copies of `ink`, `muted` and `bg`, plus the canvas-only grid colour, and receives a `dark` flag. A change to those tokens in app.css must be made in Chart.svelte as well.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set on the body, so every number aligns and no figure shifts width as values change.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All headings, labels and buttons are sentence case at normal tracking. No uppercase, no letter-spaced labels.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only a modal that floats above the whole screen casts a shadow. Cards, bars, buttons and fields are flat in every state.

dos: Do define every colour as one `light-dark()` pair on the root and let `data-theme` switch `color-scheme`; a new colour needs both values.
Do update the literal copies in Chart.svelte whenever `ink`, `muted` or `bg` changes in app.css.
Do give every run a colour and a marker shape together, and keep the first run in Ink.
Do set every figure and name about a run in Ink, beside its swatch or on its marker.
Do give each quantity its own single-axis chart; where power and torque share one, draw torque dashed 5/4 and key that in Quiet Text.
Do keep a run's inputs visible in its card, with the peak figures first.
Do separate layers with a 1px Hairline border and the Ground/Card tonal step.
Do use weights 400, 500 and 600 only, sentence case, with tabular numerals.
Do keep controls dense: 28px fields, 32px buttons, 11px labels above the control.
donts: Don't use Signal Blue for anything except the primary action, focus, selection, the caret and the drop outline; in particular, never as a run colour.
Don't put a second primary button in the same group of actions.
Don't colour text with a run colour, on the canvas or off it.
Don't tint chrome. Backgrounds, cards and borders stay on the neutral scale in both themes.
Don't add shadows to cards, bars, buttons or fields; only a modal casts one.
Don't rely on colour alone to tell runs apart, on screen or in the exported image.
Don't use Fault Red as a fill.
Don't set type in uppercase or add tracking to labels.
Don't load fonts from a remote host; nothing leaves the browser.
